source.text: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ εὐνοῦχος τῷ Φιλίππῳ εἶπεν· Δέομαί σου, περὶ τίνος ὁ προφήτης λέγει τοῦτο;

records.literal_gloss: Answering now the eunuch to Philip said, I ask you, concerning whom the prophet says this?

en.L: And the eunuch answered Philip and said, "I ask you, about whom does the prophet say this?
en.B: The eunuch said to Philip, "Please tell me, who is the prophet talking about here?
en.R: The eunuch said to Philip, "Please tell me. Who is the prophet talking about?

es.L: Y respondiendo el eunuco a Felipe, dijo: «Te ruego, ¿de quién dice esto el profeta?
es.B: El eunuco le dijo a Felipe: «Por favor, dime: ¿de quién habla aquí el profeta?
es.R: El eunuco le dijo a Felipe: «Por favor, dime. ¿De quién está hablando el profeta?

fr.L: Et l’eunuque, répondant, dit à Philippe : « Je t’en prie, de qui le prophète dit-il cela ?
fr.B: L’eunuque dit à Philippe : « Dis-moi, je te prie, de qui le prophète parle-t-il ici ?
fr.R: L’eunuque a dit à Philippe : « S’il te plaît, explique-moi. De qui le prophète parle-t-il ?

sw.L: Na yule towashi akamjibu Filipo, akasema, "Nakuomba, nabii anasema haya kuhusu nani?
sw.B: Towashi akamwambia Filipo, "Tafadhali niambie, nabii anazungumza habari za nani hapa?
sw.R: Towashi akamwambia Filipo, "Tafadhali niambie. Nabii anazungumza kuhusu nani?

vi.L: Hoạn quan nói với Phi-líp: "Xin ông cho biết, nhà tiên tri nói điều này về ai?
vi.B: Hoạn quan nói với Phi-líp: "Xin ông cho tôi biết, nhà tiên tri đang nói về ai vậy?
vi.R: Hoạn quan nói với Phi-líp: "Xin ông cho tôi biết. Nhà tiên tri đang nói về ai?

ko.L: 내시가 빌립에게 대답하여 말했다. "부탁합니다. 예언자가 누구에 관하여 이렇게 말하는 것입니까?
ko.B: 내시가 빌립에게 말했다. "말씀해 주십시오. 예언자가 여기서 누구를 두고 이렇게 말하는 것입니까?
ko.R: 내시가 빌립에게 말했다. "알려 주십시오. 예언자는 누구에 관하여 말하고 있습니까?

decisions.choice: I ask you: please, a polite request
decisions.reason: The verb means to ask or beg, used here as a courteous "please".

decisions.choice: answering: replying to the situation
decisions.reason: The participle often just introduces what someone says next.

source.text: περὶ ἑαυτοῦ ἢ περὶ ἑτέρου τινός;

records.literal_gloss: Concerning himself or concerning other someone?

en.L: About himself or about someone else?"
en.B: Is he speaking of himself, or of another person?"
en.R: Is he talking about himself or about another man?"

es.L: ¿Acerca de sí mismo o acerca de algún otro?».
es.B: ¿Habla de sí mismo o de otra persona?».
es.R: ¿Está hablando de sí mismo o de otro hombre?».

fr.L: De lui-même ou de quelqu’un d’autre ? »
fr.B: Parle-t-il de lui-même, ou d’un autre ? »
fr.R: Est-ce qu’il parle de lui-même ou d’un autre homme ? »

sw.L: Kuhusu yeye mwenyewe au kuhusu mtu mwingine fulani?"
sw.B: Je, anajisema mwenyewe, au anamsema mtu mwingine?"
sw.R: Anazungumza kuhusu yeye mwenyewe au kuhusu mtu mwingine?"

vi.L: Về chính mình hay về một người nào khác?"
vi.B: Ông ấy nói về chính mình hay về một người khác?"
vi.R: Ông ấy nói về chính mình hay về một người khác?"

ko.L: 자기 자신에 관해서입니까, 아니면 다른 어떤 사람에 관해서입니까?"
ko.B: 자기 자신을 두고 하는 말입니까, 아니면 다른 사람을 두고 하는 말입니까?"
ko.R: 자기 자신에 관하여 말하는 것입니까, 아니면 다른 사람에 관하여 말하는 것입니까?"

decisions.choice: himself or someone else: who the servant is was an open question
alternatives: the question had a settled answer
decisions.reason: The servant songs do not name the servant. Elsewhere Isaiah calls Israel God's servant (Isaiah 41:8, 49:3). The official's question opens the way for Philip's answer.

source.text: ἀνοίξας δὲ ὁ Φίλιππος τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ τῆς γραφῆς ταύτης εὐηγγελίσατο αὐτῷ τὸν Ἰησοῦν.

records.literal_gloss: Having opened then the Philip the mouth of him and having begun from the Scripture this he proclaimed the good news to him, the Jesus.

en.L: Then Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture he proclaimed to him the good news of Jesus.
en.B: Then Philip spoke up. Starting from that very Scripture, he made Jesus known to him as good news.
en.R: Then Philip began to speak. He started with this part of the Scriptures, and he told the man the good news about Jesus.

es.L: Entonces Felipe abrió su boca, y comenzando desde esta Escritura, le anunció la buena noticia de Jesús.
es.B: Entonces Felipe tomó la palabra. Comenzando por esa misma Escritura, le dio a conocer a Jesús como la buena noticia.
es.R: Entonces Felipe comenzó a hablar. Empezó con esta parte de las Escrituras y le contó al hombre la buena noticia acerca de Jesús.

fr.L: Alors Philippe ouvrit la bouche et, commençant par cette Écriture, il lui annonça la bonne nouvelle de Jésus.
fr.B: Philippe prit alors la parole. Partant de ce passage même de l’Écriture, il lui fit connaître la bonne nouvelle : Jésus.
fr.R: Alors Philippe a commencé à parler. Il est parti de ce passage des Écritures, et il a annoncé à l’homme la bonne nouvelle de Jésus.

sw.L: Basi Filipo, akiisha kufungua kinywa chake na kuanza tangu andiko hili, alimtangazia Yesu kama habari njema.
sw.B: Ndipo Filipo alianza kusema. Kuanzia andiko lile lile, alimjulisha Yesu kuwa ndiye habari njema.
sw.R: Basi Filipo alianza kuzungumza. Alianza na sehemu hiyo ya Maandiko, akamweleza mtu huyo habari njema kuhusu Yesu.

vi.L: Phi-líp mở miệng, bắt đầu từ đoạn Kinh Thánh này mà rao giảng Tin Lành về Đức Giê-xu cho ông.
vi.B: Phi-líp liền lên tiếng. Bắt đầu từ chính đoạn Kinh Thánh ấy, ông giới thiệu cho người ấy Tin Lành về Đức Giê-xu.
vi.R: Phi-líp bắt đầu nói. Ông bắt đầu từ đoạn Kinh Thánh này, và nói cho người ấy biết Tin Lành về Đức Giê-xu.

ko.L: 그러자 빌립이 입을 열어, 이 성경 말씀에서부터 시작하여 그에게 예수에 관한 복음을 전했다.
ko.B: 그러자 빌립이 입을 열었다. 그는 바로 그 성경 말씀에서 시작하여, 그에게 예수를 기쁜 소식으로 전해 주었다.
ko.R: 그러자 빌립이 말하기 시작했다. 빌립은 그 성경 말씀에서 시작해서, 그 사람에게 예수에 관한 기쁜 소식을 전해 주었다.

decisions.choice: opened his mouth: began to speak at length
decisions.reason: The phrase marks the start of a solemn speech (10:34, Matthew 5:2). It also echoes the servant who "did not open his mouth" (8:32).

decisions.choice: beginning from this Scripture: the servant is Jesus
alternatives: Philip spoke of Jesus apart from the passage
decisions.reason: Philip begins with Isaiah 53 and shows that it speaks of Jesus. The risen Jesus did the same with the Scriptures for his disciples (Luke 24:27, 24:44-47).

decisions.choice: proclaimed Jesus as good news: Jesus himself was the content of the good news
decisions.reason: The verb for announcing good news takes "Jesus" as its object, as in 5:42.

decisions.choice: spoke up
decisions.reason: Balanced uses a natural English phrase; Literal keeps the idiom.

decisions.choice: prit la parole
decisions.reason: "Prendre la parole" is the natural French for beginning to speak at length (m1), as the English Balanced "spoke up"; Literal keeps the idiom.

source.text: ὡς δὲ ἐπορεύοντο κατὰ τὴν ὁδόν, ἦλθον ἐπί τι ὕδωρ, καί φησιν ὁ εὐνοῦχος· Ἰδοὺ ὕδωρ, τί κωλύει με βαπτισθῆναι;

records.literal_gloss: As then they were going along the road, they came upon some water, and says the eunuch, Look, water; what prevents me to be baptized?

en.L: And as they were going along the road, they came to some water, and the eunuch says, "Look, water! What prevents me from being baptized?"
en.B: As they traveled on along the road, they came to some water. "There is water here!" the eunuch exclaimed. "Is there any reason I should not be baptized?"
en.R: As they went along the road, they came to a place with some water. The eunuch said, "Look! Here is some water! Is there any reason I cannot be baptized?"

es.L: Y mientras iban por el camino, llegaron a cierta agua, y dice el eunuco: «¡Mira, agua! ¿Qué me impide ser bautizado?».
es.B: Siguiendo su camino, llegaron a un lugar donde había agua. «¡Aquí hay agua!», exclamó el eunuco. «¿Hay alguna razón para que yo no sea bautizado?».
es.R: Mientras iban por el camino, llegaron a un lugar donde había un poco de agua. El eunuco dijo: «¡Mira! ¡Aquí hay agua! ¿Hay alguna razón para que no me puedan bautizar?».

fr.L: Et comme ils allaient le long de la route, ils arrivèrent à un point d’eau, et l’eunuque dit : « Voici de l’eau ! Qu’est-ce qui m’empêche d’être baptisé ? »
fr.B: Comme ils poursuivaient leur route, ils arrivèrent près d’un point d’eau. « Il y a de l’eau ici ! s’écria l’eunuque. Y a-t-il une raison pour que je ne sois pas baptisé ? »
fr.R: Pendant qu’ils avançaient sur la route, ils sont arrivés à un endroit où il y avait de l’eau. L’eunuque a dit : « Regarde ! Il y a de l’eau ici ! Est-ce que quelque chose m’empêche d’être baptisé ? »

sw.L: Na walipokuwa wakienda njiani, walifika mahali penye maji, na towashi anasema, "Tazama, maji! Ni nini kinachonizuia kubatizwa?"
sw.B: Walipokuwa wakiendelea na safari njiani, walifika mahali penye maji. Towashi akasema kwa mshangao, "Hapa kuna maji! Je, kuna sababu yoyote nisibatizwe?"
sw.R: Walipokuwa wakienda njiani, walifika mahali penye maji kidogo. Towashi akasema, "Tazama! Hapa kuna maji! Je, kuna sababu yoyote ya mimi kutobatizwa?"

vi.L: Đang khi đi trên đường, họ đến chỗ có nước, và hoạn quan nói: "Kìa, có nước; có gì ngăn trở tôi chịu báp-têm không?"
vi.B: Họ tiếp tục đi trên đường thì đến một chỗ có nước. Hoạn quan reo lên: "Ở đây có nước! Có lý do gì tôi không được chịu báp-têm không?"
vi.R: Khi họ đi trên đường, họ đến một nơi có nước. Hoạn quan nói: "Kìa! Ở đây có nước! Có lý do gì mà tôi không thể chịu báp-têm không?"

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 길을 가다가 물이 있는 곳에 이르렀다. 그러자 내시가 말한다. "보십시오, 물이 있습니다. 제가 세례를 받는 데 무슨 거리낌이 있습니까?"
ko.B: 그들이 길을 가다가 물이 있는 곳에 이르렀다. 내시가 외쳤다. "여기 물이 있습니다! 제가 세례를 받지 못할 까닭이 있습니까?"
ko.R: 그들은 길을 가다가 물이 있는 곳에 이르렀다. 내시가 말했다. "보십시오! 여기 물이 있습니다! 제가 세례를 받으면 안 될 이유가 있습니까?"

decisions.choice: what prevents me: is there anything to stop me
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer "nothing". The same verb is used when Peter asks whether anyone can prevent the baptism of Cornelius's household (10:47; compare 11:17). The man the law kept out (Deuteronomy 23:1) asks what keeps him out now.

decisions.choice: says: a vivid present tense in a past narrative
decisions.reason: Greek often uses the present tense to make a scene vivid. Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: SBLGNT has no verse 37
decisions.reason: Verse 37 is missing from the earliest and most important manuscripts and is not in the SBLGNT. It is found in later manuscripts, in some forms of the old Latin, and in the King James Version. In it Philip says he may be baptized if he believes with all his heart, and the eunuch answers that he believes that Jesus Christ is the Son of God. It looks like an early baptismal confession added to the story. Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: said (R), exclaimed (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep the past tense of the story.

decisions.choice: "hoạn quan nói" (L), with no "đã" for the historic present
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps the historic present at Literal by leaving out "đã".

decisions.choice: "말한다" (L), the historic present
decisions.reason: As the style guide gives for Literal (section 3): Luke's vivid present is kept. The SBLGNT has no verse 37 (meaning decision), so the Korean has none either.

source.text: καὶ ἐκέλευσεν στῆναι τὸ ἅρμα, καὶ κατέβησαν ἀμφότεροι εἰς τὸ ὕδωρ ὅ τε Φίλιππος καὶ ὁ εὐνοῦχος, καὶ ἐβάπτισεν αὐτόν.

records.literal_gloss: And he ordered to stop the chariot, and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.

en.L: And he ordered the chariot to stop, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.
en.B: He gave orders to halt the chariot, and the two of them, Philip and the eunuch, went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
en.R: The eunuch told the driver to stop the chariot. Philip and the eunuch both went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.

es.L: Y mandó detener el carruaje, y bajaron ambos al agua, tanto Felipe como el eunuco, y lo bautizó.
es.B: Dio orden de parar el carruaje, y los dos, Felipe y el eunuco, bajaron al agua, y Felipe lo bautizó.
es.R: El eunuco le dijo al conductor que detuviera el carruaje. Felipe y el eunuco bajaron juntos al agua, y Felipe lo bautizó.

fr.L: Et il ordonna que le char s’arrête, et ils descendirent tous deux dans l’eau, Philippe et l’eunuque, et il le baptisa.
fr.B: Il fit arrêter le char ; tous deux, Philippe et l’eunuque, descendirent dans l’eau, et Philippe le baptisa.
fr.R: L’eunuque a dit au conducteur d’arrêter le char. Philippe et l’eunuque sont descendus tous les deux dans l’eau, et Philippe l’a baptisé.

sw.L: Naye akaamuru gari lisimame, nao wakashuka wote wawili majini, Filipo na towashi, naye akambatiza.
sw.B: Akatoa amri gari lisimamishwe, na wote wawili, Filipo na towashi, wakashuka majini, na Filipo akambatiza.
sw.R: Towashi alimwambia mwendesha gari alisimamishe. Filipo na towashi wote wawili walishuka majini, na Filipo akambatiza.

vi.L: Ông ra lệnh dừng xe lại, rồi cả hai, Phi-líp và hoạn quan, cùng xuống nước, và Phi-líp làm báp-têm cho ông.
vi.B: Ông ra lệnh dừng xe, rồi cả hai, Phi-líp và hoạn quan, cùng xuống nước, và Phi-líp làm báp-têm cho ông.
vi.R: Hoạn quan bảo người đánh xe dừng xe lại. Cả Phi-líp và hoạn quan đều xuống nước, và Phi-líp làm báp-têm cho ông.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 수레를 멈추라고 명령했다. 그리고 빌립과 내시 두 사람이 물로 내려갔고, 빌립이 그에게 세례를 주었다.
ko.B: 그는 수레를 세우라고 명령했다. 그리고 빌립과 내시 두 사람이 물로 내려갔고, 빌립이 그에게 세례를 주었다.
ko.R: 내시는 마부에게 수레를 세우라고 했다. 빌립과 내시는 둘 다 물속으로 내려갔다. 그리고 빌립이 내시에게 세례를 주었다.

decisions.choice: he ordered: the official gave the command to his driver
decisions.reason: The official is the one with servants under him. The subject of "baptized" is Philip.

decisions.choice: went down into the water: they stepped into the water for the baptism
decisions.reason: The phrase says they went down into the water and came up out of it (8:39). It does not describe how the baptism was done.

decisions.choice: Philip baptized him
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name who did the baptizing, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: the eunuch told the driver
decisions.reason: Readable names who gave the order and to whom.

source.text: ὅτε δὲ ἀνέβησαν ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος, πνεῦμα κυρίου ἥρπασεν τὸν Φίλιππον, καὶ οὐκ εἶδεν αὐτὸν οὐκέτι ὁ εὐνοῦχος, ἐπορεύετο γὰρ τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ χαίρων.

records.literal_gloss: When now they came up out of the water, [the] Spirit of Lord carried away the Philip, and not saw him no longer the eunuch, he went for the way of him rejoicing.

en.L: And when they came up out of the water, [the] Spirit of [the] Lord snatched Philip away, and the eunuch saw him no longer, for he went on his way rejoicing.
en.B: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord suddenly took Philip away. The eunuch did not see him again, but he traveled on with a glad heart.
en.R: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord suddenly took Philip away. The eunuch never saw Philip again. But he went on his way home, full of joy.

es.L: Y cuando subieron del agua, [el] Espíritu del Señor arrebató a Felipe, y el eunuco ya no lo vio más, pues siguió su camino gozoso.
es.B: Cuando salieron del agua, el Espíritu del Señor se llevó de repente a Felipe. El eunuco no volvió a verlo, pero siguió su viaje con el corazón alegre.
es.R: Cuando salieron del agua, el Espíritu del Señor se llevó de repente a Felipe. El eunuco nunca volvió a ver a Felipe. Pero siguió su camino a casa, lleno de alegría.

fr.L: Et quand ils furent remontés de l’eau, l’Esprit du Seigneur enleva Philippe, et l’eunuque ne le vit plus, car il poursuivait son chemin en se réjouissant.
fr.B: Quand ils furent sortis de l’eau, l’Esprit du Seigneur emporta soudain Philippe. L’eunuque ne le revit plus, mais il continua sa route, le cœur plein de joie.
fr.R: Quand ils sont sortis de l’eau, l’Esprit du Seigneur a tout à coup emmené Philippe. L’eunuque n’a plus jamais revu Philippe. Mais il a repris la route de chez lui, plein de joie.

sw.L: Na walipopanda kutoka majini, Roho wa Bwana alimnyakua Filipo, na yule towashi hakumwona tena, kwa maana alienda zake akifurahi.
sw.B: Walipotoka majini, Roho wa Bwana alimchukua Filipo ghafla. Towashi hakumwona tena, lakini aliendelea na safari yake akiwa na moyo wa furaha.
sw.R: Walipotoka majini, Roho wa Bwana alimchukua Filipo ghafla. Towashi hakumwona Filipo tena. Lakini aliendelea na safari yake kurudi nyumbani, akiwa amejaa furaha.

vi.L: Khi họ ra khỏi nước, Thánh Linh của Chúa đem Phi-líp đi, và hoạn quan không còn thấy ông nữa, vì ông cứ vui mừng tiếp tục lên đường.
vi.B: Khi họ lên khỏi nước, Thánh Linh của Chúa thình lình đem Phi-líp đi. Hoạn quan không thấy Phi-líp nữa, nhưng ông vẫn tiếp tục lên đường với lòng đầy vui mừng.
vi.R: Khi họ lên khỏi nước, Thánh Linh của Chúa thình lình đem Phi-líp đi. Hoạn quan không bao giờ gặp lại Phi-líp nữa. Nhưng ông tiếp tục lên đường về nhà, lòng đầy vui mừng.

ko.L: 그런데 그들이 물에서 올라왔을 때에 주님의 영께서 빌립을 데려가셨다. 그래서 내시는 그를 더 이상 보지 못했다. 그는 기뻐하며 자기 길을 갔다.
ko.B: 그들이 물에서 올라오자, 주님의 영께서 갑자기 빌립을 데려가셨다. 내시는 빌립을 다시 보지 못했지만, 기쁨에 넘쳐 자기 길을 갔다.
ko.R: 그들이 물에서 올라오자, 주님의 영께서 갑자기 빌립을 데려가셨다. 내시는 다시는 빌립을 보지 못했다. 그러나 그는 기쁨에 가득 차서 집으로 가는 길을 계속 갔다.

decisions.choice: snatched away: took away suddenly and by force
decisions.reason: The verb means to seize or carry off. Obadiah fears the Spirit of the Lord will carry Elijah away (1 Kings 18:12; compare 2 Kings 2:16). Paul uses it of being caught up to the third heaven (2 Corinthians 12:2).

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "the Spirit of the Lord snatched Philip away"
alternatives: "the Holy Spirit fell on the eunuch, and an angel of the Lord snatched Philip away"
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts, mainly of the Western text, say the Holy Spirit fell on the eunuch and an angel of the Lord took Philip away. The shorter reading is better attested. The longer one may have been added to show that the eunuch too received the Spirit. Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: for he went on his way rejoicing: the eunuch did not stay to look for Philip
alternatives: he never saw him because he left
decisions.reason: The "for" explains why the eunuch saw Philip no more: he did not stay but went on his road home, glad.

decisions.choice: rejoicing: glad, full of joy
decisions.reason: Joy follows the coming of salvation in Acts (8:8, 13:48, 16:34).

decisions.choice: but
decisions.reason: English shows the link more naturally with a contrast; the reason is clear from the story.

decisions.choice: "주님의 영께서 ... 데려가셨다", with "갑자기" (B, R) for harpazō
decisions.reason: To snatch away is to take away suddenly and by force (meaning decision); Korean says the suddenness with an adverb, since "낚아채다" would sound violent rather than wondrous.

source.text: Φίλιππος δὲ εὑρέθη εἰς Ἄζωτον, καὶ διερχόμενος εὐηγγελίζετο τὰς πόλεις πάσας ἕως τοῦ ἐλθεῖν αὐτὸν εἰς Καισάρειαν.

records.literal_gloss: Philip however was found at Azotus, and passing through he was proclaiming the good news to the towns all until the coming him to Caesarea.

en.L: But Philip was found at Azotus, and passing through, he proclaimed the good news to all the towns until he came to Caesarea.
en.B: Philip, for his part, turned up at Azotus. He went on through the region, announcing the good news in every town until he reached Caesarea.
en.R: Later Philip found himself in the town of Azotus. He traveled through that area and told the good news about Jesus in all the towns. He did this until he came to the city of Caesarea.

es.L: Pero Felipe fue hallado en Azoto, y al pasar, anunciaba la buena noticia a todas las ciudades hasta llegar él a Cesarea.
es.B: Felipe, por su parte, apareció en Azoto. Siguió recorriendo la región y anunciando la buena noticia en todos los pueblos hasta llegar a Cesarea.
es.R: Después Felipe se encontró en el pueblo de Azoto. Viajó por esa región y contó la buena noticia acerca de Jesús en todos los pueblos. Lo hizo hasta que llegó a la ciudad de Cesarea.

fr.L: Mais Philippe fut trouvé à Azot, et, traversant [la région], il annonçait la bonne nouvelle à toutes les villes, jusqu’à ce qu’il arrive à Césarée.
fr.B: Philippe, quant à lui, se retrouva à Azot. Il traversa la région en annonçant la bonne nouvelle dans toutes les villes, jusqu’à son arrivée à Césarée.
fr.R: Plus tard, Philippe s’est retrouvé dans la ville d’Azot. Il a voyagé dans toute cette région et il a annoncé la bonne nouvelle de Jésus dans toutes les villes. Il a fait cela jusqu’à son arrivée dans la ville de Césarée.

sw.L: Lakini Filipo alionekana huko Azoto, na akipita, alihubiri habari njema katika miji yote mpaka alipofika Kaisaria.
sw.B: Filipo, kwa upande wake, alitokea Azoto. Akaendelea kupita katika eneo hilo, akihubiri habari njema katika kila mji mpaka alipofika Kaisaria.
sw.R: Baadaye Filipo alijikuta katika mji wa Azoto. Alisafiri katika eneo hilo, akiwaeleza watu habari njema kuhusu Yesu katika miji yote. Aliendelea kufanya hivyo mpaka alipofika katika mji wa Kaisaria.

vi.L: Còn Phi-líp thì có mặt tại A-xốt, và ông đi qua, rao giảng Tin Lành tại tất cả các thành cho đến khi ông tới Sê-sa-rê.
vi.B: Còn Phi-líp thì xuất hiện tại A-xốt. Ông đi qua khắp vùng, rao giảng Tin Lành tại mọi thành cho đến khi tới Sê-sa-rê.
vi.R: Sau đó Phi-líp thấy mình đang ở thị trấn A-xốt. Ông đi khắp vùng ấy và nói Tin Lành về Đức Giê-xu tại tất cả các thị trấn. Ông làm như vậy cho đến khi tới thành Sê-sa-rê.

ko.L: 그러나 빌립은 아소도에 나타났다. 그리고 그는 두루 다니며 가이사랴에 이를 때까지 모든 성에 복음을 전했다.
ko.B: 빌립은 아소도에 나타났다. 그는 그 지방을 두루 다니며, 가이사랴에 이를 때까지 모든 성에서 복음을 전했다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 빌립은 아소도라는 마을에 있게 되었다. 빌립은 그 지방을 두루 다니면서 모든 마을에서 예수에 관한 기쁜 소식을 전했다. 그는 가이사랴라는 도시에 이를 때까지 그렇게 했다.

decisions.choice: Azotus: the Greek name of Ashdod, on the coast north of Gaza
decisions.reason: Ashdod was one of the old Philistine cities (1 Samuel 5:1). From there the coast road runs north to Caesarea.

decisions.choice: Caesarea: the port city built by Herod, seat of the Roman governors
decisions.reason: This is Caesarea on the coast. Philip still lives there years later (21:8).

decisions.choice: was found at: appeared, turned up at
decisions.reason: The passive form is used for someone who arrives unexpectedly at a place, as in the Greek of 1 Kings 18:12.

decisions.choice: the good news about Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable names what the good news was about, as in 8:35.

decisions.choice: Azot
decisions.reason: The usual French form of the Greek name of Ashdod (m1).

decisions.choice: "A-xốt", "Sê-sa-rê"
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms of the names (Sê-sa-rê for the whole book).

decisions.choice: "아소도", "가이사랴"
decisions.reason: The Protestant forms of the names (style guide, Settled); "가이사랴" as in the Korean Matthew 16:13.
